details:
Currently, as many post have pointed out, the performance ranking system is not fine-grained, and many users would rather not use it to avoid hiding too many avatars which lie in the very poor rank. I am not meant to support very poor avatars, but as you could see, the hard threshold is easily exceeded for today's average booth models with only little additional decorations, while some other avatars with multiple body mesh, clothes, bones and animations also falls into the very same "very poor" category. 

I noticed that there is a hide globally option for an avatar, and I find it useful to block avatars that has a significant impact on my frame rate （some very poor avatars reduce the frame rate by approximately 5 while some has an impact of 20-30）. However, I also noticed that the current option is not designed for this purpose, as hiding an avatar is similar to blocking the avatar of a specific user, which uses a default "robot" character instead of a fallback or impostor.

I wonder if VRChat can implement some handy functions for the players to block avatars of really bad performance, while still showing their fallbacks or impostors, since the hiding is not for any safety purpose. In case the ranking system is not re-worked, implementing some performance-aimed blocking option would also be considered a patch for the current system.

I also recommend integrating the impostor option into more existing performance blocking/ culling systems, as having the impostors alone without multiple convenient and customizable ways of showing impostor instead of original avatars will hinder the use of this system as a strong tool for boosting performance.

The suggestion is based on my observation of the current menu and functions, if I missed any existing options that do the job, please feel free to point out. Thank you
title: An option for hiding a specific avatar for performance reasons
